title: Scholia v0.6.2 cross-step Action result closure
description: Shared positive and negative fixtures for Rule 4. Each expectation applies specifically to action_recorded; adapters may also assert whole-trace validity when no other rule is intentionally exercised.

cases.description: A Finding recursively nested inside the Action records its result.
cases.trace:
<Step id="S_01">
  <Action id="Act_01">Applied the requested change.
    <Finding id="F_01">The nested result is recorded.</Finding>
  </Action>
</Step>

cases.description: A goal-closing Concluding recursively nested inside the Action records its result.
cases.trace:
<Step id="S_01">
  <Goal id="G_01" scope="trace" priority="required">Apply and verify the requested change.</Goal>
  <Observation id="Obs_01">The verification command passed.</Observation>
  <Action id="Act_01">Applied the requested change.
    <Concluding id="C_01" for_goal="G_01" status="met">REFER:Obs_01 establishes completion.</Concluding>
  </Action>
</Step>

cases.description: An immediate Finding sibling in the same Step preserves the legacy acceptance form.
cases.trace:
<Step id="S_01">
  <Action id="Act_01">Applied the requested change.</Action>
  <Finding id="F_01">The immediate result is recorded.</Finding>
</Step>

cases.description: An immediate goal-closing Concluding sibling in the same Step records the Action.
cases.trace:
<Step id="S_01">
  <Goal id="G_01" scope="trace" priority="required">Apply and verify the requested change.</Goal>
  <Observation id="Obs_01">The verification command passed.</Observation>
  <Action id="Act_01">Applied the requested change.</Action>
  <Concluding id="C_01" for_goal="G_01" status="met">REFER:Obs_01 establishes completion.</Concluding>
</Step>

cases.description: A later cross-step Finding directly REFERs the Action after an intervening Observation.
cases.trace:
<Step id="S_01">
  <Action id="Act_01">Applied the requested change.</Action>
</Step>
<Step id="S_02">
  <Observation id="Obs_01">The scoped test command completed.</Observation>
</Step>
<Step id="S_03">
  <Finding id="F_01">The scoped tests passed. REFER:Act_01</Finding>
</Step>

cases.description: A later Finding REFERs an Observation that directly REFERs the Action.
cases.trace:
<Step id="S_01">
  <Action id="Act_01">Applied the requested change.</Action>
</Step>
<Step id="S_02">
  <Observation id="Obs_01">The scoped tests passed. REFER:Act_01</Observation>
</Step>
<Step id="S_03">
  <Finding id="F_01">The action result is verified. REFER:Obs_01</Finding>
</Step>

cases.description: A later Finding REFERs Evidence that directly REFERs the Action.
cases.trace:
<Step id="S_01">
  <Action id="Act_01">Applied the requested change.</Action>
</Step>
<Step id="S_02">
  <Evidence id="E_01" polarity="supports">The verification command passed. REFER:Act_01</Evidence>
</Step>
<Step id="S_03">
  <Finding id="F_01">The action result is verified. REFER:E_01</Finding>
</Step>

cases.description: A later Concluding directly REFERs the Action and closes a declared Goal.
cases.trace:
<Step id="S_01">
  <Goal id="G_01" scope="trace" priority="required">Apply and verify the requested change.</Goal>
  <Action id="Act_01">Applied the requested change.</Action>
</Step>
<Step id="S_02">
  <Observation id="Obs_01">The scoped tests passed.</Observation>
</Step>
<Step id="S_03">
  <Concluding id="C_01" for_goal="G_01" status="met">REFER:Act_01 AND REFER:Obs_01 establish completion.</Concluding>
</Step>

cases.description: A generic records_result graph edge links a Finding source to the Action target.
cases.trace:
<Step id="S_01">
  <Action id="Act_01">Applied the requested change.</Action>
</Step>
<Step id="S_02">
  <Observation id="Obs_01">The scoped test command completed.</Observation>
</Step>
<Step id="S_03">
  <Finding id="F_01">The scoped tests passed.</Finding>
</Step>

cases.description: A later Finding that only REFERs unrelated material does not record the Action.
cases.trace:
<Step id="S_01">
  <Action id="Act_01">Applied the requested change.</Action>
</Step>
<Step id="S_02">
  <Observation id="Obs_unrelated">The weather report was retrieved.</Observation>
</Step>
<Step id="S_03">
  <Finding id="F_01">The unrelated lookup completed. REFER:Obs_unrelated</Finding>
</Step>

cases.description: A non-immediate later Finding without an explicit provenance link is insufficient, even when it follows the Action chronologically.
cases.trace:
<Step id="S_01">
  <Action id="Act_01">Applied the requested change.</Action>
</Step>
<Step id="S_02">
  <Observation id="Obs_01">The scoped test command completed.</Observation>
</Step>
<Step id="S_03">
  <Finding id="F_01">The scoped tests passed.</Finding>
</Step>

cases.description: An unlinked Finding at the start of the next Step is not an immediate same-Step sibling and does not record the Action.
cases.trace:
<Step id="S_01">
  <Action id="Act_01">Applied the requested change.</Action>
</Step>
<Step id="S_02">
  <Finding id="F_01">The scoped tests passed.</Finding>
</Step>

cases.description: An Action with no recording result remains invalid.
